items.title: Preserve both main histories and behaviors in one verified merge
items.context: Resolve eleven observed content conflicts using original commit intent; retain remote-only changes, exact playback branding, and local receipt repair behavior with negative tests.
items.userSees: Both parent histories remain reachable and Proof-or-stop playback/export branding remains visible after normal publication.

happy.desc: Read-only Git checks prove both d5b00d0ff3 and c853ab5e63 are ancestors of integrated HEAD and playback.js remains byte-identical to branding commit c8263eb450, including initial/post-parse Proof-or-stop headings and exported frame branding.
Merged CLI retains Lab and config routing and aligned package/lockfile/runtime versions; existing cli-surface-smoke and version-bump-smoke pass against the built merge.

edge.desc: Existing english-early-check-smoke passes against compiled merged code, resolves repository guidance correctly and retains early rejection of non-English authoring artifacts.
Existing done-required-validation-smoke passes with canonical ambient transport neutrality, semantic and explicit-overlay sensitivity, and unchanged historical key-list digest.

adversarial.desc: Existing verification-run-and-guard-smoke passes while retaining remote context/provenance separation, pinned docs recovery, true execution timestamps and local mixed-selector negative assertions; mismatched commands, absent selectors and failing verifiers never mint passing mechanical evidence.
